item.title: Reconciliation of Fate and Freewill
item.description:
Reconciliation of Fate and Freewill Ramesh Krishnamurthy, Kuntimaddi Sadananda and Shyam Subramanian

Source: TW

Author: Ramesh Krishnamurthy, Kuntimaddi Sadananda and Shyam Subramanian

For more information about Shyam Subramanian, read his blog ‘Self Knowledge’.
You may also read his other contributions at this site.

The following were posted to the Advaitin Egroup in May 2009.

1. Kuntimaddi Sadananda

Free will is there… until I am free from will.

Here is a beautiful shloka from Bhagavan Ramana in ‘sat darshanaM’ (‘Forty Verses in Reality’). He says, as always in his characteristic style of brevity:
